text:
sara: Quick sync: starting onboarding for talon-13b (qlora). weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/talon13b/qlora/2026-03-10/ — config.json in the tarball. Looking for tokenizer sanity check and a quick perf sweep.

hamid: @sara noted. I'll check tokenizer — last talon variant had EOS token differences ('') vs None. Which tokenizer type? huggingface/gpt2 vs sentencepiece?

sara: It's HF BPE (gpt2-like). config.json lists "tokenizer": "gpt2" and special_tokens_map includes "": "<|eos|>". The archive has vocab.json + merges.txt + tokenizer_config.json. Can you confirm behavior on leading spaces?

matt: I pulled the tarball. tokenizer_config.json has "add_prefix_space": false. Quick local encode showed a leading-space mismatch for prompts that start with a space. Might need add_prefix_space=true.

hamid: Good catch. Running a diff against our reference tokenizer now. If we flip add_prefix_space it may change token counts in padded batches.

benchbot: benchbot: kicked off perf sweep talon13b-2026-03-10 on dedicated-staging. Params: batch_sizes=[1,2,4,8], seq_lens=[64,256,1024], samples=100 each. Artifacts will be uploaded to /artifacts/talon13b/2026-03-10/

sara: FYI runtime config recommends kv_cache_shards=4. Can we sanity-check memory on p4d-16? initial mem estimate ~96GB per shard.

yana: @sara I can run a single-shard memory smoke. If we use q4_0 quantization we should be within limits. Which quant builds to include in catalog?

sara: We want both float16 (baseline quality) and q4_0 (cost-optimized). Catalog should reference both and label q4_0 as "low-cost".

matt: benchbot partial results: seq=64 b=1 p50=45ms p95=82ms p99=120ms; b=4 p50=60ms p95=110ms p99=170ms. seq=256 b=1 p50=210ms p95=320ms.

hamid: Tokenizer diff shows add_prefix_space=false causes off-by-one for prompts starting with spaces. I'm going to patch tokenizer_config.json -> add_prefix_space=true and re-run tokenization tests.

julie: Code-review ping @hamid on the tokenizer patch — tiny PR open in model-registry. Also can you bump catalog manifest max_input_length to 2048? Some perf runs hit truncation at 1024.

sara: Keep catalog max_input_length=2048 but add guidance: "recommendation: prefer 1024 for low-latency tiers".

benchbot: benchbot: float16 sweep complete. Summary (1-shot, 32 tokens): batch=1 p50=48ms; q4_0 throughput ~820 tokens/s on dedicated nodes. Uploading full logs to /artifacts/talon13b/2026-03-10/

matt: Drafting perf note for Console: kv_shards=4, recommended batch 2-4 for latency-sensitive paths, 8+ for throughput. Call out tokenizer change and quantization tradeoffs.

sara: Next steps: @hamid push tokenizer fix + tag new weights, @julie merge catalog PR, @benchbot re-run q4_0 with add_prefix_space=true and seq=1024. I'll schedule a short rollout window tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
